alt: 兩位鄰居在敞開的花園門前握手，旁邊的水管已解開並整齊收好。
scene_prompt: In a community garden after a disagreement, two neighbors who stood on opposite sides of a low fence now warmly shake hands through its open gate while a mutual friend smiles in relief. Between them a formerly tangled garden hose has been completely untangled and neatly coiled; both now share the watering work. Clearly show the dispute fully resolved and barriers dissolved, not a fight. Use the dictionary sense of a problem being completely resolved, not literal melting ice and broken tiles.
